claims.claim_text: 每個寫入都拿一個單調遞增的 sequence number，內部存的是 (user_key, sequence_number, value_type) 三元組
claims.evidence: Internally, RocksDB assigns each inserted key a monotonically increasing number, which it calls a _sequence number_. ... what actually gets into the memtable and SST files on disk is a triplet of _(user_key, sequence_number, value_type)_, stored together with the value.

claims.claim_text: 快照、原子批次、兩種交易的衝突偵測，全都歸結到比較 sequence number
claims.evidence: Snapshots, atomic batches and conflict detection in both transaction flavors all come down to the same primitive - comparing sequence numbers.

claims.claim_text: 樂觀交易更把 key 雜湊進整整 1M 個預先配好的 mutex 來做提交時驗證
claims.evidence: Instead of tracking individual locked keys in a shared map, the lock manager hashes keys into 1M pre-allocated mutexes.

claims.claim_text: Reddit 要求登入才能看 old.reddit.com，理由是舊版是「濫用式爬取與自動流量的重要來源」
claims.evidence: Old Reddit's logged-out experience is a significant source of abusive scraping and automated traffic on the platform.

claims.claim_text: old Reddit 供的是不需 JavaScript 的純 HTML、一頁約 1MB，新版要跑 JS、載入約五倍內容
claims.evidence: Old Reddit does 33 page requests totalling about 1 MB ... you don't even need JS unless you want to load more comments. New Reddit does 112 requests loading about 5x more content.

claims.claim_text: Hugging Face 七月十六日先獨立揭露，OpenAI 五天後才跟進
claims.evidence: Huggingface released [the blog] on the 16th of July, 5 days before OpenAI released [their announcement].

claims.claim_text: 這大概是第一個已知、而且是非蓄意的自主攻擊型 agent
claims.evidence: This is likely the first _known_ autonomous offensive agent working like this, and certainly the first known one where an agent has done this inadvertently.

claims.claim_text: tinyrenderer 用大約 500 行 C++、不碰任何圖形函式庫，從零把一套軟體算繪器蓋起來
claims.evidence: The final code consists of about 500 lines. ... using no third-party libraries (especially graphics-related ones).

claims.claim_text: 「我不打算教你怎麼寫 GPU 程式，而是要讓你懂它們怎麼運作」
claims.evidence: I do not intend to show how to write GPU applications — I want to show how they work.

claims.claim_text: 一般人跑完大約要 10 到 20 小時
claims.evidence: My students typically require 10 to 20 hours of programming to start producing such renderers.

claims.claim_text: pip 26.2 加了 --only-deps，可以只裝 pyproject.toml 裡的相依、不裝專案本身
claims.evidence: pip install --only-deps . # project.dependencies ... The feature is expected in Pip 26.2 for July 2026.

claims.claim_text: 拖了近二十年才到，是因為得先有 pyproject.toml 與 PEP 735 這些底子，加上 uv 的流行才把需求推上檯面
claims.evidence: PEP 517 (2017): Introduced pyproject.toml hooks ... PEP 735 (2023): Added dependency groups to pyproject.toml ... After the introduction of pyproject.toml and the fast growing popularity of uv it suddenly started to make a lot more sense.

claims.claim_text: macOS 上可以在不需提權的情況下，靜默換掉一個受信任 App 的主執行檔
claims.evidence: silently replace the main executable of any application downloaded from the web without requiring elevated privileges.

claims.claim_text: 被換掉的執行檔則落到 ad hoc 簽章，照樣能啟動；Apple 七月十四日以不修正結案，也沒給 CVE
claims.evidence: The replaced executable, however, is ad hoc signed, and macOS permits ad hoc signed executables to run. ... Apple concluded on July 14, 2026 that the reported behaviour does not constitute a security issue ... closed as wontfix with no CVE assignment mentioned in the timeline.

claims.claim_text: 傳統用 unique_ptr 做 PImpl 有三個老問題：const 不會傳遞、moved-from 留下懸空指標要防、還有一堆特殊成員函式的樣板碼；std::indirect 給值語意，五個特殊成員函式全部可以 default 掉
claims.evidence: A problem that may seem subtle is that constness is not propagated from Widget to Impl. ... a moved-from Widget object has a null pimpl_ pointer and calling any function that use the pointer is undefined behavior. ... through a const std::indirect<T> object, you only get const access to the T ... [the five special members] are still declared in the header but they are defaulted...in the source file.

claims.claim_text: 一篇論文追了 232,270 條 dataset→model→application 的授權傳遞鏈，發現 62.3% 的鏈裡至少經過一個沒有標示授權的 artifact
claims.evidence: We trace 232,270 dataset→model→application chains ... 62.3% of chains pass through at least one artifact with no declared license

claims.claim_text: 帶義務的授權端到端存活率不到 7%，寬鬆授權卻有 95.1%
claims.evidence: every obligation-bearing license category falls below 7% end-to-end survival while the Permissive category reaches 95.1%

claims.claim_text: 共用同一座受電力限制資料中心的多個獨立 AI 訓練工作會意外同步，讓電力波動隨工作數量線性放大，而不是原本預期的平方根
claims.evidence: when many independent training jobs share one oversubscribed power envelope, do their cycles stay independent, so aggregate fluctuation grows as the square root of the number of jobs, or can the power-management stack phase-lock them into linear growth? ... We identify the coupling channel in load-dependent throttling: caps, voltage droop, and shared cooling slow computation exactly when aggregate demand is high.

claims.claim_text: 作者用廣義 Kuramoto 系統來描述，並指出用 phase-scattering 排程可以打散這個效應
claims.evidence: Formalizing the fleet as a generalized Kuramoto system, we obtain three operator-facing statements. ... Mitigate: phase-scattering scheduling raises every mode threshold at once.

claims.claim_text: Solar-Open2-250B：250B 總參數、每個 token 只活化 15B 的混合注意力 MoE，脈絡長度達 1M，宣稱 SWE-Bench Verified 70.4、LiveCodeBench 92.4，只搬了 2.3% 權重初始化
claims.evidence: 250B-A15B open-weight large language model with Hybrid-Attention Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that activates only 15B per token ... 1M-Token Context ... SWE-Bench Verified 70.4 and LiveCodeBench (v6) 92.4 ... Only the 2.3% of weights that survive the architectural change are carried over.
